WITH max_dt AS (SELECT MAX(actual_order_date) AS max_date FROM Actual_Orders),
cust AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         c.customer_name,
         strftime('%Y-%m', ao.actual_order_date) AS order_month,
         p.product_price AS order_value
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
  JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
),
emp AS (
  SELECT e.employee_id,
         e.employee_name,
         strftime('%Y-%m', ao.actual_order_date) AS order_month,
         p.product_price AS order_value
  FROM Employees e
  JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON od.driver_employee_id = e.employee_id
  JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
  JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
  JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = e.employee_address_id
  WHERE a.state_province_county = 'California'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT customer_id AS person_id, customer_name AS person_name, order_month, order_value FROM cust
  UNION ALL
  SELECT employee_id AS person_id, employee_name AS person_name, order_month, order_value FROM emp
),
totals AS (
  SELECT person_id, person_name,
         SUM(order_value) AS total_order_value
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY person_id, person_name
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT c.person_id,
         c.person_name,
         c.order_month,
         SUM(c.order_value) AS month_sum
  FROM combined c
  CROSS JOIN max_dt mx
  WHERE date(c.order_month || '-01') >= date(mx.max_date, '-12 months')
    AND date(c.order_month || '-01') <= date(mx.max_date)
  GROUP BY c.person_id, c.person_name, c.order_month
),
running AS (
  SELECT m.person_id,
         m.person_name,
         m.order_month,
         m.month_sum,
         SUM(m.month_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY m.person_id ORDER BY m.order_month
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM monthly m
)
SELECT r.person_name,
       t.total_order_value,
       r.order_month,
       r.running_total
FROM running r
JOIN totals t ON t.person_id = r.person_id
ORDER BY r.person_name, r.order_month;

-- Customers located in California
cal_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name

    JOIN "Addresses" a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.state_province_county = 'California'
),
-- Employees located in California
cal_employees AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name
    FROM "Employees" e
    JOIN "Addresses" a ON e.employee_address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.state_province_county = 'California'
),
-- Monthly order value for California customers (past 12 months)
cust_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        cc.customer_id AS entity_id,
        cc.customer_name AS entity_name,
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.actual_order_date) AS order_month,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS month_value
    FROM cal_customers cc
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON cc.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON ro.regular_order_id = o.regular_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON o.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.actual_order_date >= date((SELECT MAX(actual_order_date) FROM "Actual_Orders"), '-12 months')
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id, cc.customer_name, order_month
),
-- Monthly order value for California employees (past 12 months) based on deliveries
emp_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        ce.employee_id AS entity_id,
        ce.employee_name AS entity_name,
        strftime('%Y-%m', od.delivery_date) AS order_month,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS month_value
    FROM cal_employees ce
    JOIN "Order_Deliveries" od ON ce.employee_id = od.driver_employee_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON od.actual_order_id = o.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON o.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE od.delivery_date >= date((SELECT MAX(delivery_date) FROM "Order_Deliveries"), '-12 months')
    GROUP BY ce.employee_id, ce.employee_name, order_month
),
-- Combine monthly values
monthly_all AS (
    SELECT * FROM cust_monthly
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM emp_monthly
),
-- Running total per entity over months (ordered chronologically)
monthly_running AS (
    SELECT
        entity_id,
        entity_name,
        order_month,
        month_value,
        SUM(month_value) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY order_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_all
),
-- Total order value (all time) for California customers
cust_total AS (
    SELECT
        cc.customer_id AS entity_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_order_value
    FROM cal_customers cc
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON cc.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON ro.regular_order_id = o.regular_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON o.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
),
-- Total order value (all time) for California employees
emp_total AS (
    SELECT
        ce.employee_id AS entity_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_order_value
    FROM cal_employees ce
    JOIN "Order_Deliveries" od ON ce.employee_id = od.driver_employee_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON od.actual_order_id = o.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON o.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY ce.employee_id
),
-- Combine totals
total_all AS (
    SELECT * FROM cust_total
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM emp_total
)
SELECT
    mr.entity_name,
    ta.total_order_value,
    mr.order_month,
    mr.running_total
FROM monthly_running mr
JOIN total_all ta ON mr.entity_id = ta.entity_id
ORDER BY mr.entity_name, mr.order_month;
